headline: Kazakhstan's KMF Bank Borrows $30 Million From OPEC Fund for SME Lending
summary: Kazakhstan-based KMF Bank secured a $30 million loan facility from the OPEC Fund for International Development to expand credit access for small and medium enterprises.
why: KMF Bank is a major microfinance lender in Kazakhstan, providing debt capital to rural micro and small businesses.

impacts.name: KMF Bank
impacts.why: A $30 million OPEC Fund credit facility increases KMF's lending liquidity for domestic SMEs.
